entries.en: (Error)
This lost lamb is writhing in pain...[n]Hahaha.
If you grant me [f 2 5 3 9999 3],[n]perhaps salvation will come...[n]What is your decision?
This lost lamb is writhing in pain...[n]Hahaha.
Let's see... If you grant me a tithe of[n][var 0] yen, perhaps I may be willing[n]to release them.
This lost lamb is enduring a great pain...[n]Won't you grant them salvation?
I ask for a tithe of your health. Only then[n]shall I consider releasing them.
This lost lamb is enduring a great pain...[n]Won't you grant them salvation?
I ask for a tithe of your stamina. Only[n]then shall this lamb rejoin the flock.
Fine, you win.
I can't meet your demands.
Call Thieves Guild ([var 5] left).
[clr 2]You're up, Panther.[clr 27]
You lack sincerity. I shall not release[n]this lamb unless our Father wills it.
...This time, I ask for [f 2 5 3 9999 3].[n]Be calm and submit to our Father.
...This tithe isn't enough. This lamb[n]cannot return to the flock with just this.
This time, I ask for a tithe of [var 0] yen.[n]Allow me to ascertain your sincerity...
...Our Father is not satisfied. Perhaps we[n]should ask for more.
This time, He demands your health.[n]You must be willing to sacrifice yourself[n]as our Father did.
...More sacrifices must be made if we are[n]to prove our authority over you mortals.
This time, I ask for your stamina. I shall[n]ascertain how much you're willing to[n]sacrifice...
...Very well. It's about time I return this[n]lost lamb to flock.
...I truly understand your resolve now.[n]I shall return this lost lamb to flock.
Will you forsake this lamb? Blasphemy...
I did not wish for such an end... but[n]judgment must be called.
You show no leniency even to those[n]beloved by our Father?
Allow me to dispel this notion. May[n]Father grant them mercy.
Will you forsake this lamb? Blasphemy...
I cannot converse with one capable of[n]such despicable actions... Farewell.
Filthy child of sin. Repent your merciless[n]ways.
Our Father is watching you at all times. I[n]shall release this lamb and take my leave.
Well then, I shall take my leave. Good[n]day to you...
There is no need for me to quarrel with[n]you any longer. I shall take my leave...
Well then, let us finish this battle.[n]Prepare yourself!
...This will suffice. Now then, let us[n]resume.
Father! To think this child would be this[n]prepared!
Who dares disturb my sermon!?
Stop that at once! I shall forgive you, but[n]grant me [f 2 5 3 9999 3].
Hopeless child of Man! I shall only allow[n]such impudence for a tithe of [var 0] yen.
Stop that at once! Fine, I shall forgive you[n]if you grant me your health.
Such immaturity! I shall only allow such[n]impudence if you grant me your stamina.
O-Oh Father... Was I too harsh? Calm[n]down and don't mind my words!
Dear Father... To think that I would forget[n]mercy. Perhaps I shall take my leave...
You do not have what I require.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No... How could you take that from us?
Another band of thieves[n]responded to the call!
